business_problem: InMobi needed to migrate a latency-sensitive advertising platform from another hyperscaler, preserve zero-downtime service at massive QPS, and create a more efficient real-time serving and analytics environment for both auction traffic and future GenAI workloads.
solution_summary: InMobi executed a staged migration to Google Cloud that combined core-serving modernization with a large analytical data plane. Google Kubernetes Engine now hosts containerized real-time serving workloads, using custom ComputeClasses and autoscaling features to react to volatility in spot capacity. Cloud Storage holds petabytes of supply-side platform data, Hyperdisk provides low-latency block storage for performance-critical paths, and Databricks on Google Cloud plus Cloud Composer support distributed processing and hundreds of orchestrated data pipelines. The company also mapped additional workloads onto Compute Engine and Cloud SQL during the migration, then used Bigtable and in-memory caching in the serving layer to keep ad-delivery latency low. The result is a platform that can process millions of queries per second and tens of millions of ML inferences daily with zero downtime while lowering infrastructure cost and setting up future agentic advertising work on Vertex AI.

data_flow: Ad-serving requests hit GKE-hosted services in the real-time path, where cached and low-latency data layers help return responses quickly. Large historical datasets live in Cloud Storage and flow through Databricks and Cloud Composer pipelines for analytics, model development, and future Vertex AI workloads.
